name: contact-form-7
notes: issue #3509 records the wpcf7 environment classification below.

The admitted line is exactly the audited Contact Form 7 6.0.x and 6.1.x releases ([6.0, 6.2.0)). The exact wordpress.org 6.0 package and current 6.1.7 are the boundary artifacts; 5.9.8 is the adjacent installed negative control. The minimum deliberately matches the official plugin header's 6.0 spelling because PHP version comparison does not treat 6.0 as >= 6.0.0. A future 6.2 release remains blocked until its source and exact artifact are reviewed rather than being trusted by a broad major-version range.

All current property metadata was produced through WPCF7_ContactForm::get_template()+save(), not hand-authored rows. _form and _additional_settings are strings; _mail/_mail_2 and _messages are closed string-bearing objects and use the recursive plain-data codec so home URLs rebind without changing their serialized types; _locale and _hash have exact plugin-consumed grammars.

The modern [contact-form-7] callback resolves exactly the first seven lowercase-hex characters of persisted _hash. CF7 6.0.x generates a 40-byte SHA-1 value, 6.1.x generates a 64-byte SHA-256 value, and an in-place 6.0-to-6.1 upgrade retains the existing 40-byte identity because save() adds _hash uniquely rather than replacing it. Both exact native widths are admitted; every other width refuses. A raw source prefix can select an unrelated target form, so the required id attribute is canonicalized to the owning post token and apply restores the repository-authored witness. Missing, duplicate, malformed, unmanaged, or source/target-colliding prefixes refuse before publication or mutation; title-only, numeric, and other fallback identity forms remain unsupported rather than relying on mutable titles.

The legacy formatter emits [contact-form <old_id> "<title>"], whose positional integer resolves through _old_cf7_unit_id rather than wp_posts.ID. The positional rule canonicalizes that alternate to the same post token in post bodies and structured string leaves, then restores the repository-authored alternate; missing, duplicate, non-positive, non-decimal, overflow, and wrong-domain values refuse loudly.

CF7 6.x still reads the pre-3.3 unprefixed form/mail/mail_2/messages/additional_settings property names. The digest-bound interpreter admits exactly one current-or-legacy spelling per property and rejects dual or incomplete storage. It also classifies native _config_errors/_config_validation/_flamingo residue as runtime and _constant_contact/_sendinblue integration configuration as environment-owned, only in an anchored CF7 form context; unknown plugin extensions stay unclassified and loud.
The manifest declares the non-public wpcf7_contact_form post type so Capture can discover and gate CF7 forms; site.wprism.json still controls the site's broader post_type scope.

wpcf7 is environment-owned and optional: the one settings blob mixes the installed-version upgrade gate, validation/admin state, and optional reCAPTCHA, Turnstile, Stripe, and Brevo credentials. It never enters canonical state and has no authored sub-key carve-out; target values must survive apply unchanged.
